title: NTA National Common Entrance Test NCET 2026 Result - Out
intro: National Testing Agency (NTA)  has Officially Released Result for the National Common Entrance Test (NCET) for admission to 4-Year Integrated Teacher Education Programme (ITEP) in selected Central/ State University/ Institutions including IITs, NITs, RIEs, and Government Colleges for the Academic Session 2026. Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to this Jobs. Exam Held On April 17-18, 2026 & Result Released On June 4, 2026. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Download Result Now in the Given Link Below.
importantDates: SC/ ST/ PwBD/ Third Gender: Rs. 650/-
Payment Mode: Pay the Exam Fee Through Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking Cash Card Fee Mode.
Fee Payment Last Date : 11 March 2026 (11:50 PM)
No Age Limit for Registration in NCET 2026.
Candidates Passed Class 12th / Equivalent examination Or Appearing in 2026 Examination are eligible for apply.
The final examination of the 10+2 system, conducted by any recognized Central/ State Board.
Intermediate or two-year Pre-University examination conducted by a recognized Board/ University.
Final examination of the two-year course of the Joint Services Wing of the National Defence Academy.
Senior Secondary School Examination conducted by the National Institute of Open Schooling with a minimum of five subjects.
Any Public School/ Board/ University examination in India or any foreign country is recognized as equivalent to the 10+2 system by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU).

i. Candidates who have completed the Class 12 (or equivalent) examination outside India or from a Board not specified above should produce a certificate from the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) to the effect that the examination they have passed is equivalent to the Class 12 Examination.
Indira Gandhi National Open University IGNOU
Mahatma Gandhi Chitrakoot Gramodaya Vishwavidyalaya Rajaula MP
Dr. B R Ambedkar National Institute of Technology Lidhran Bidhipur
Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur West Bengal
Maharaja Purna Chandra Autonomous College Odisha
Dr B R Ambedkar University Etcherla Main Road Srikakulam, Andhra Pradesh
Mode of the Test : Computer Based Test (CBT)
Test Pattern: Objective type with Multiple Choice Questions
Medium: 13 languages (Assamese, Bengali, English, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Punjabi, Odia, Tamil, Telugu, and Urdu )

Syllabus:  Language: Language to be tested through Reading Comprehension, Literary Aptitude, and Vocabulary || Domain Subject: As per Class 12 syllabus only || General Test: General Knowledge, Current Affairs, General Mental Ability, Numerical Ability, Quantitative Reasoning, Logical and Analytical Reasoning  ||  Teaching Aptitude: Topics related to the teaching of science, Arts, Mathematics, Performing Arts, Languages, etc.
10 March 2026: Last date for registration & fee payment (11:50 PM).
11 March 2026: Last date for fee payment (11:50 PM).
No Age Limit for NCET 2026 registration.
Educational Qualification: Passed / appearing in 10+2 or equivalent examination from recognized board/university.
Qualifying Examinations: 10+2 from Central/State Board, NIOS, Intermediate, Pre-University, NDA, Vocational, Foreign Boards (AIU equivalence required), etc.
Note: Detailed eligibility codes & requirements in official brochure.
Dr B R Ambedkar NIT Jalandhar
Dr BR Ambedkar University, Srikakulam (Andhra Pradesh)
4-Year ITEP: Integrated Teacher Education Programme in top institutions (IITs, NITs, Central Universities, RIEs & more).
No Age Limit: Open for 10+2 passed/appearing candidates.
